findings.problem: srs-fin.md §A8 lists FIN's SEC dependencies (User, ModuleRegistry, ScreenRegistry, ActionRegistry) as HARD-FK, but db-script-fin.md §2 assigns no XM row for any of them (only XM-FIN-001, SOFT-READ to MDL, exists) — a literal reading of A8 vs the XM register looks inconsistent at first glance.
findings.fix: No content change needed — ADR-FIN-001 (erp/decisions/FIN/ADR-FIN-001.md, carried into P3.1 with cited traces) explicitly reconciles this: no physical cross-module FK exists anywhere in this pipeline (confirmed against SEC's and MDL's own scripts), so P2 correctly assigns no XM for those SEC rows, treating them as platform-standard integration (auth interceptor, self-registration) narrated in P3.1 Phase 1/Phase 7 instead — the same precedent SEC's and MDL's own P3.1 plans already established. Recommend a future factory-level refinement: P1's own template could accept a 'FUNCTIONAL' dependency kind distinct from HARD-FK/SOFT-READ to avoid this exact tension recurring for every future module.
